title: Chapter 1: Phone
description: SMS events that play after the kiosk scene. Content varies based on player choices.

nodes.text: Later that evening. You're sitting on the step outside Mama Achieng's kiosk, phone in hand. The sky is turning orange over the estate rooftops.
[SMS from Mum]: Bibi amepokea. Asante sana, {player_name}. Kula vizuri.
nodes.gloss: Bibi received it. Thank you very much, {player_name}. Eat well.

nodes.text: [SMS from Jabali]: Yo {player_name}! U were so quiet in the mat today lol. Deep thinker ama you were just sleeping? 😂 Anyway M-Pesa is legit bro check it out. Tutaongea.
[SMS from Jabali]: {player_name}! My guy! U told Mama Achieng STRAIGHT today 😂😂. Banks are shaking!! I knew u were smart. Holla anytime u need a free ride on Msafiri 😎
[SMS from Jabali]: Aye {player_name}, next time remove the earphones! Life is happening around u bro! But no stress. Msafiri doors are always open for u. Literally, the door doesn't close properly 😂
[SMS from Mama Achieng']: {player_name}. Thank you for today. You have patience. Your mother raised you well. Come tomorrow — I will have mandazi for you. Don't tell anyone, I don't want a queue.
nodes.gloss: mandazi = sweet fried dough, like a doughnut

nodes.text: [SMS from Mama Achieng']: {player_name}. I figured it out WITHOUT your help. But. Thank you for sitting there. Even company that laughs at you is still company. Next time bring manners.
You smile at the phone. Somewhere across Nairobi, Bibi has her fare. Mama Achieng' has her M-Pesa. And you — you have a story to tell.
